params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: page
params.description: The 0-based index number of the page of activities to retrieve.</br>**Minimum:** `0`</br>**Default:** `0`

params.name: perPage
params.description: The maximum number of activities to list per page.</br>**Minimum:** `0`</br>**Default:** `100`

params.name: from
params.description: The beginning of the date range, in [ISO 8601](https://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime) format, for which to list activities. If not specified, the parameter will be set as the current date and time.</br>The end range must be within 31 days of the beginning range.</br>**Example:** `2018-05-22T23:36:30.589Z`

params.name: to
params.description: The end of the date range, in [ISO 8601](https://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime) format, for which to list activities.</br>The end range must be within 31 days of the beginning range.</br>**Example:** `2018-05-23T23:36:30.589Z`

items.docs:
Retrieves a page of [activities](https://docs.coveo.com/en/173/) matching the specified time interval and filters in the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).

**Required privilege:** Activities - View

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"ACTIVITIES","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
